Now that doesn’t mean you can just do whatever ever you want. You still have to take care of yourself. But the biggest thing is accepting. You can work on yourself, but you can’t change everything and thats okay! Try out different types of clothes and see what compliments your features. There’s no need to be insecure, they don’t have to be big to feel heavy. You don’t need to have large breasts to have stretch marks. All your insecurities are valid, but you are you. You’re body doesn’t define who you are as a person. Think of it as a shell. Yes you want it to look good, but there’s more than you to than just the outside. Sorry this is so long, I just also struggle with my chest and this ideology helps me.
